title: Prebid Server zeroclickfraud adapter fixture: sparse optional-asset fill, no bidfloor

source.name: prebid/prebid-server — adapters/zeroclickfraud/zeroclickfraudtest/exemplary/native.json (mockBidRequest + mockResponse)
source.notes: Facts (field shapes, required/optional composition, adapter ext keys), not prose, are reused per the clone's own ATTRIBUTION.md; the fixture's own creative title/description text is not reproduced. NOTICE file absent upstream, which only removes §4(d), not the licence itself.

modifications: device.ip changed from the fixture's public-looking 8.8.8.10 to the RFC 5737 TEST-NET-3 address 203.0.113.20 — no real IP is retained.
user.buyeruid changed from the fixture's numeric constant to the clearly synthetic string buyeruid-fixture-0001.

ext.bidder.host changed from the fixture's live-looking q.0cf.io to the reserved adapter.example.test domain; ext.bidder.sourceId is kept as the fixture's own non-identifying numeric adapter config constant.
link.url and the imptrackers[] URL changed from the fixture's live-looking t.0cf.io host to reserved advertiser.example.test / track.example.test domains.

Top-level BidRequest/BidResponse id, imp.id and bid.impid renamed to this corpus's id convention; bid.id, cid, adid and crid are left as the fixture's own literal numeric test constants (already non-functional placeholders in the public fixture, not live identifiers).

Title and description creative text are original — the fixture's own ad copy ('Datablocks Inc.' / 'Datablocks provides world class...') is prose, not a field shape, and is not reproduced per the source's own ATTRIBUTION.md.

Assets 1 (img), 2 (data type 1) and 4 (data type 6) are omitted from the response exactly as the fixture omits them — none are required, so this is the fixture's own real sparse-fill behaviour, not an invented mutation.
provenance.sanitized: Only synthetic identifiers, original fixture creative text, reserved domains and TEST-NET addresses. No live tokens, subscriber IDs or real tracking URLs.
provenance.notes: vendor-adapter-fixture; see modifications for every substitution.

pairApplicability.note: The fixture's mockBidRequest/mockResponse.body are a real bid-response-to-bid-request pair (impid resolves, id matches after renaming).

specNotes: Protocol validity is based on cited fields, not on current Core output. Optional-field warnings do not make this pair invalid.

IAB Native 1.1/1.2 §4.2 Object: Asset Request — `required` defaults to 0 (optional) when omitted. Assets 1, 2 and 4 are optional in the request and legitimately omitted from the response; only asset 0 (title, required) must be present for completeness.

The response adm declares native ver 1.2 while the request declared ver 1.1 on the same fixture — a genuine, faithful-to-source version drift from the real adapter, not an authoring mistake; neither side's version is asserted here.

No imp.bidfloor is present in the source fixture (a real, common vendor shape) — crosscheck.js defaults the floor to 0 and still emits crosscheck.bid.no_floor_set (WARN) once per imp; the numeric compare still runs against that defaulted floor.
No image asset is returned (asset 1 is optional and omitted) — a title+description text-only card is the intended complete creative, not a failed image load.

The source fixture's device object carries only ip, no ua — a real, common vendor shape (OpenRTB 2.5/2.6 §3.2.18 device.ua is optional). packages/core/rules-request.js unconditionally requires device.ua at ERROR for any non-DOOH request; this is the same underlying cause already recorded as DEF-100 for video/audio pairs, extended here to native. See knownGap.
Browser assertions are proposed observables; this corpus has not been run in a browser for this case.
Do not infer rendering from analysis.status or iframe existence alone.
Inspect intended click target without following it.
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.
